runs.t: The Red Cat and the Rat
The red cat sees a rat.
The red cat runs to get the rat.
The rat is fast. The red cat is not as fast.
The rat runs to a hut.
The rat got in the hut.
The red cat did not fit in the hut.
The rat got rid of the red cat.
